a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def gcd_calc(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

num = 0
den = 1
min_diff = 1e9

for j in range(1, n + 1):
    low_i = (j * a) // b - 1
    high_i = (j * a) // b + 1
    for i in range(low_i, high_i + 1):
        diff = abs(i / j - a / b)
        if diff < min_diff:
            min_diff = diff
            num = i
            den = j

g = gcd_calc(abs(num), den)
print(f"{num // g}/{den // g}")
